ambiguous.note: short ton (2000 lb), long ton (2240 lb) and metric tonne (1000 kg) are all called ton
US liquid gallon (3.785411784 L) and imperial gallon (4.54609 L) differ by about 20 percent
avoirdupois ounce, troy ounce and the fluid ounces (US and imperial) share the symbol
US liquid pint (473.176473 mL), imperial pint (568.26125 mL), dry pint, and pt is also the point and the pico-tonne
thermochemical calorie (4.184 J) and International Table calorie (4.1868 J) differ by about 0.07 percent
British thermal unit exists in several definitions (IT, thermochemical, 39 F, 59 F, 60 F, mean)
international mile, US survey mile and nautical miles differ
mechanical (745.7 W), metric (735.5 W), electrical (746 W) and boiler horsepower differ
parts per million by mass, by volume or by amount of substance are different quantities (composition kinds arrive in M2)
